## Summary

Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

This review found one optional correction. The complete-report test covers legacy-header rejection, while the other legacy-header test passes before the parser checks the header.

## Changes

The parser now requires the exact header `REPORT v1`. The pull request adds two tests intended to verify rejection of `REPORT v0`.

## Critical

(none)

## Important

(none)

## Suggestions

- tests/test_report.py:11 — tests — Remove the ineffective legacy-header test — The fixture becomes `REPORT v1\nversion=v0` because `rsplit("v1", 1)` replaces the body value. Without `END`, the parser returns `None` before checking the header. — This test passes even if the parser accepts legacy headers.
